<thought>The main ion at m/z 224.120 likely corresponds to [M+H]⁺, giving a neutral mass of about 223.113 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈ 17 % of M) suggests roughly 16 carbons. A formula C₁₆H₁₅O has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 223.1123 Da, matching the observed mass within experimental error. Hence the molecular formula is C16H15O.</thought>
<final_answer>C16H15O</final_answer>
